match.serves: you serve the first point; then the winner of each rally serves the next point (a let: the same server); the opponent serves like you, by the rules

spec.robot: franka-panda (held to the real Panda's joint velocity, acceleration, jerk, torque and torque-rate limits) on a 1.0 m pedestal, base on an x-y gantry of ball-screw axes (Festo EGC-185-BS-KF-40P: <= 2 m/s, <= 15 m/s^2, jerk <= 375 m/s^3, 3000 N) + badminton racket (head centre 0.56 m beyond the flange, string bed radius 0.14 m)

shuttle.model: point mass, gravity 9.81 + quadratic drag: dv/dt = g - K |v| v
shuttle.bounce: none: the rally ends when it reaches the floor

act.rule: an act (and none) takes effect 14 control steps after the step at which it arrives (the stroke is planned meanwhile; the reply gives effect_step, the state shows pending_commands, and a command sent before then is refused with HTTP 409); T counts from the effect step

court.service_court: between the short service line and the back line, on one side of the centre line x = 0 (lines in)

racket.law: speed out = gain x max(0, v_head . n) x (1 - offcentre_loss (r / radius)^2) + incoming_share x max(0, -v_in . n), along the face normal n

velocity_rule.text: the servo runs the arm's setpoints at 0.9 of the joint velocity limits; a physical arm joint faster than 1.05 x its limit triggers the robot's velocity reflex: the targets are ignored, the arm brakes to rest at the pose of the trigger and the gantry to rest within its limits, for 1 s; then the robot resumes from rest and catches up with its targets within the limits (the stroke under way is lost; final fields velocity_reflexes)

spec.frame: your own: x to your right, y towards the opponent, z up; your half y < 0, your base's home [0.0, -1.6]

serve.courts: both robots stand in their right service courts when the server's score is even, else in their left ones (diagonally opposite); the spot is your base's home for the point
serve.command: {'type': 'toss', 'pos': [x, y, z], 'height': H}: the shuttle appears at the point when the command takes effect (the same lead as an act) and rises H straight up (0 <= H <= 0.5; 0 or omitted: released from rest); then hit it with an act (it may be sent before the toss)
serve.phases: serve.phase: waiting (the receiver is getting ready), open (toss now), tossed, done
serve.faults: serve faults are recorded as 'serve_fault:<reason>: ...' (reasons: undue_delay, missed, too_high, not_upwards, net, out, moved); the receiver's base moving early: 'receive_fault:moved: ...'

spec.image: 2 rows (behind, side) x 4 columns (camera frames 60 ms apart, oldest left); tile 480 x 360

t.doc: contact T s after the act takes effect (0 < T <= 5)

pos.doc: racket-head centre at contact: |x| <= 2.136, -3.68 <= y <= -0.3, 0.2 <= z <= 3.0

base.doc: optional: where the base stands at contact (your frame; within the base's range); default the forehand stance for pos (the stance formula); the base stays there after the stroke

act.feasible: the platform delivers a request within the tolerances when the contact is at least about 0.9 s ahead from the ready pose, 0.65-1.75 m high, within the base's reach in time and the head speed within about 2.2 t - 0.2 m/s along a forward face; otherwise it does its best and says so (FAILURES).
act.replaces: a new act (or none) replaces the stroke under way from its effect step; the swing restarts from the moving arm

notes.stance: the base's goal for a contact at pos = (x, y, z) is (x, y) - 0.62 r (1, 1) with r = max(0.30, 0.95 - 0.35 |z - 1.333|) m (a forehand: right of and in front of the base), clipped to the gantry's range; the reply's stroke.base_goal gives it. So a serve whose contact is at that offset from the base's spot keeps the base still (it must stay within 5 cm until the serve is hit)
notes.timing: an act takes effect act.lead_steps control steps after the step at which it arrives (2 at x20); the plan is made meanwhile from the exact state at that step
notes.feedback: the reply: effect_step and the stroke notes (stroke, base, speed_scale, blade_error_m, normal_error_deg, racket_vel_delivered); state.command: contact_in_s, vel_rehearsed, pos_error_rehearsed_m; last_shots
notes.contact_law: the shuttle leaves along the face normal at 4 max(0, v_head.n)(1 - 0.3 (r/0.14)^2) + 0.15 max(0, -v_in.n) (spec racket_contact): the player turns the shot it wants into (normal, vel)

pos.doc: your serve's toss (docs/conventions/racket_serve_zh.md): the shuttle appears at this point (your frame) when the command takes effect; 0.5 <= z <= 1.8, within 1.0 m (horizontally) of your base, y <= -0.5; only the server, once per serve, from the step the receiver is ready (state.serve)

height.doc: how far it rises straight up from pos (0 <= height <= 0.5; default 0: released from rest)

toss.feasible: every toss within the ranges and the serve's window is executed exactly

last_points.how: the opponent's shot hit the net (x=0.64, height 0.69 m)
missed: the shuttle landed in your court at x=0.02, y=-1.49

last_shots.summary: the opponent's shot hit the net (x=0.64, height 0.69 m)
good: the opponent played it (weak return, a lift)
missed: the shuttle landed in your court at x=0.02, y=-1.49

state.command: none (the arm returns to / holds the ready pose, the base waits at its last target or move point)

feedback.stroke: could not reach the stance in time: 0.22 m short
